description: Central Province Provincial Council - Notify the Entertainment Tax of Yatinuwara and Kundasale P/S
categorisation: This gazette content primarily concerns the imposition and regulation of entertainment taxes by provincial councils under specific ordinances and acts (Entertainment Tax Ordinance, Tax Amendment Act). It involves legal/regulatory matters rather than government personnel changes, structural changes, or any of the other specialized categories. The content focuses on statutory instruments and regulatory compliance requirements for taxation.
